blocks.text: 2743 Sandon Drive Abbotsford East Abbotsford V2S 7J3

parts.t: Welcome to this beautifully updated ½ duplex offering 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 1,202 sq. ft. of comfortable living space—with no strata fees! The bright interior features an updated kitchen and flooring, creating a fresh, move-in-ready feel. Step outside to your private, fully fenced backyard with a spacious wood deck, perfect for relaxing, entertaining, kids or pets. A garage and plenty of additional parking provide excellent convenience. A great opportunity to enjoy privacy, outdoor space and homeownership without monthly strata fees!

v: Bright 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom home with updated kitchen, flooring and a fresh move-in-ready feel.
Fully fenced private backyard with a spacious wood deck for entertaining, kids and pets.
Half duplex ownership with no monthly strata fees, offering added flexibility and affordability.
Garage plus additional parking for everyday convenience.
Primary bedroom with a 14' x 7' walk-in closet.
